notes: Official IDK Corporation datasheet (Ver.1.0.0, 201001), distributed via AV-iQ CDN, includes the manufacturer's own front/rear panel diagrams confirming port layout for the Decoder (-R) side: front panel has USB1/USB2, IR INPUT and RS-232C (both 3-pin captive screw terminals) and a DIP-SW; rear panel has HDMI OUTPUT, LAN (RJ-45), 10GbE (2x LC for SFP+ transceiver), and DC12-48V IN with an FG ground screw. The NJR-P01UF-R decoder itself has no AC inlet — it runs on external DC (12-48V) supplied by an included dedicated AC adapter (100-240VAC in / DC 12V 3A out), so the port is modeled as dc-barrel rather than iec/nema. IR INPUT and RS-232C are captive-screw terminal blocks (3-pin), not true XLR/euroblock — "euroblock" was chosen as the closest listed connector id since no captive-screw-terminal option exists. USB ports are HID-class only (keyboard/mouse extension for KVM), not general USB data, but are physically USB Type-A female. The 10GbE/LC-SFP+ port is the actual AV-over-IP signal path (carries video, audio, USB-HID, RS-232 and LAN tunneled together from the paired NJR-P01UF-T encoder) — graded eth-10g since it runs over 10 Gigabit Ethernet infrastructure via SFP+; the separate RJ-45 LAN port is a conventional 10/100/1000 control/management port. Unit is a compact quarter-rack-wide desktop chassis (4.2"W x 1.1"H x 7.1"D), not a full rack-mount product, so rackUnits is omitted. Note: a separate ruggedized chassis variant "NJR-P01UFR-R" exists with different connectors (Neutrik opticalCON/etherCON/powerCON) for staging use — this response covers the standard NJR-P01UF-R only, per the exact model queried.

ports.name: HDMI OUTPUT
ports.note: Female HDMI Type A (19-pin), HDMI/DVI 1.0 TMDS single link, HDCP 1.4/2.2, up to 4K@60 4:4:4 (18 Gbps); rated HDMI 1.4 dot-clock/TMDS range but supports 4K60 4:4:4 signals typical of HDMI 2.0-class content

ports.name: 10GbE
ports.note: 2x LC (duplex) via SFP+ optical transceiver; carries IP-NINJAR AV-over-IP payload (video/audio/USB/RS-232/LAN) from the NJR-P01UF-T encoder over fiber

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: RJ-45, 10Base-T/100Base-TX/1000Base-T auto-negotiation, Auto MDI/MDI-X; control/management network port, separate from the 10GbE fiber signal path

ports.name: RS-232C
ports.note: 3-pin captive screw terminal (Tx, Rx, G), full duplex, up to 115.2 kbps; closest connector match to captive-screw terminal block

ports.name: IR INPUT
ports.note: 3-pin captive screw terminal (P, S, G); closest connector match to captive-screw terminal block, functionally an IR input

ports.name: DC12-48V IN
ports.note: External DC input, 12-48V DC, powered by supplied dedicated AC adapter (AC 100-240V input, DC 12V 3A output); unit draws about 10 Watts
